title: Clan Flameshade
html:
Clan Flameshade is a faction of Duergar from the Underdark. They were hired as mercenaries by  Nere to enslave others and employ them in the Grymforge.

Background

Members of Clan Flameshade can be found throughout Grymforge, either torturing gnome slaves from Clan Ironhand, manning checkpoints or exploring Grymforge and its history. They are led by  Elder Brithvar, who can be convinced to double-cross  Nere.

According to the  Speak with Dead dialogue with  Skarjall the clan came from the city of  Dunspeirrin beneath the  Orsraun Mountains.
